Luiz,

I downloaded a free pdb tool (TL-PDB I think is the name), but the
help doc is in chinese. It is pretty easy to use, just open a text
file and save as a pdb file. I then use Palmreader to read the pdb on
my treo 650. I have the card texts and errata/rulings converted
already and can send them to you along with the text file themselves
if ya want. I don't find much use for the tournament rules and
judging guidelines.

Email me off-list at tigernat1_at_yahoo.com and I will send you the
zip file of the tool as well as the text and pdb files.

This applies to anyone else who would like them as well.

Vegas gNat

Hi Luiz,

I was making these for a while (see www.vtesinla.org for examples)
using some free software that I downloaded. There are a number of free
sites for making the conversions online. Not too terribly difficult
but all of them were a bit fiddly and each had things they could do
better. If you were willing to pay for a tool you'd probably have
better luck. I liked iSilo the best because it has graphics but it
isn't free. Plucker is free. :)

-Robert
